Built from the ground up

Iron & Ivy is a strength and endurance training studio, started by two women who wanted to build something on their own terms — for everyone who's ever felt like the gym wasn't built with them in mind.

We're starting small and local: real training cohorts, in real gyms near you, growing one session at a time.

What to expect

Functional strength and endurance training, coached for every body and every level — from your first class to your next race.

Small group cohorts

Group strength and conditioning sessions, brought to gym spaces around Aurora and Richmond Hill — wherever we're training next.

Real progressions

Whether you're brand new or training for a Spartan race, the work scales to you — not the other way around.
